reference.description: Sentinel-2C L2A SCL, 2026-07-15T10:46:41.387Z, automatic optical water reference

reference_caveat: The optical reference precedes NISAR by 4.34 days; tides and actual change may differ. SCL is an automatic classifier, not field ground truth. Spatially correlated pixels do not provide independent validation samples; any binomial interval is descriptive only.
